sok.text: The kami are spirits at war with the mortal world, and the more of them that pass through the veil that separates them from the mortal world, the weaker that veil becomes. Hundreds of minor kami spill through a rip in the veil, and the kami trapped for eons in the sacred gong destroy their prison.

Even the most benevolent kami, the kirin, join the war against the mortal world, and Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms. He and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami.
